_comment: EG4-LL Battery — Protocol Codes (PDF V01.06)
Source: EG4-LL-MODBUS-Communication-Protocol.pdf V01.06 (2017-06-21)
Keys follow the protocol_settings convention: documented_name + '_codes'.
Registers using Data_Type._16BIT_FLAGS use 'bN' keys (bit index).
Registers using Data_Type._8BIT use integer string keys (decoded byte value).
WARNING / PROTECTION / ERROR (regs 26-28):
Data type _16BIT_FLAGS. Multiple bits may be set simultaneously.
These bit layouts are from PDF V01.06 and differ from the newer ll_s firmware.
Do NOT apply the ll_s protection bit map to these registers — the bit
assignments are completely different (e.g. bit 0 = Pack_OV here vs Cell_OV in ll_s).
STATUS (reg 25, low byte):
Data type _8BIT. Mutually exclusive enum values from a single byte.
Keys are the decimal string of the raw byte value.
High byte of reg 25 is a separate field (heater_state).
HEATER STATE (reg 25, high byte):
Data type _8BIT. Two valid values: 0 (off) and 128 (0x80, on).

warning_codes._comment: PDF reg 26. Bit layout from PDF V01.06 §3 Warning register.

protection_codes._comment: PDF reg 27. Same layout as warning except b13 = Discharge_SC (not Float_Stopped).

error_code_codes._comment: PDF reg 28. Sparse bitmask — bits 3 and 5-15 are undefined in the PDF.

_comment: PDF reg 25 LOW BYTE (_8BIT at 25.b0). Mutually exclusive enum.
Keys are decimal string of the raw byte value (0-255 range).
High nibble 0x80 = BMS active (managing load), 0x00 = inactive (standby/idle).
Low nibble encodes operating mode.

heater_state_codes._comment: PDF reg 25 HIGH BYTE (_8BIT at 25.b8). 0x80 = heat on, 0x00 = heat off.
